source.sha256_method: sha256 over 2 tables' full unfiltered COPY (ORDER BY <pk-or-natural-key>) WITH (FORMAT CSV) output, each preceded by a 'TABLE:<schema>.<table>' header line, concatenated in fixed alphabetical order: nq_basicdata.stock (ORDER BY code), nq_biography.biography (ORDER BY code, engname, capacity, engtitle)
source.reuse_note: nq_basicdata.stock content overlaps byte-for-byte with the batch already pinned by security_master/security_profile/financial_facts/quote_snapshot/corporate_actions/sdi_disclosure, but this promotion's own correctness argument depends on the exact 2-table set it reads together (entity scope + the biography table itself), so it mints its own self-contained batch rather than cross-referencing another promotion's pin -- same reasoning every prior promotion used for its own batch.

promotion.new_migration_reason: Like sdi_disclosure (the first Netquity slice whose domain had no pre-existing value), no 'directorate'/'biography'/'directors' domain value existed anywhere in aiphabee_core.serving_dataset_domain_check. deploy/database/migrations/20260716120000_directorate_domain.sql extends the CHECK constraint (drop + re-add, the same mechanism the ipo_pipeline/hkex_news/sdi_disclosure domain migrations each used) with no table creation, access grant, or data load.
promotion.serving_dataset_domain_note: dataset and domain use the identical value 'directorate' (both are new values minted together by this promotion, so no pre-existing naming convention constrained a match, the same as sdi_disclosure/sdi_disclosure).
promotion.new_index_required_reason: entity_id lookup uses the leading prefix of the existing serving_record unique index (serving_snapshot_id, entity_type, entity_id, ...)

rights_basis.distinct_from_quote_snapshot: quote_snapshot deliberately uses its own 'netquity-market-data-staging.v1' policy version because market-data Web distribution rights were confirmed separately; directorate has no comparable separate rights determination and is covered by the original Netquity collaboration rights approval already used by security_master/security_profile/financial_facts/corporate_actions/sdi_disclosure, so this promotion reuses 'netquity-collaboration-staging.v1' rather than minting a new policy version.
rights_basis.account_context_independence: resolveDirectorate filters aiphabee_governance.data_entitlement/aiphabee_core.serving_dataset by context.rights_policy_version (the account's platform.workspace_product_access.policy_version), the same as resolveProfile/resolveFinancialFacts/resolveCorporateActions/resolveSdiDisclosure -- no hardcoded policy-version constant is introduced.
rights_basis.personal_data_basis: name/age/title/biography are the statutorily mandated HKEX Listing Rules Appendix 13 / Companies Ordinance 'Biographical Details of Directors and Senior Management' annual-report disclosure this dataset exists to publish (the same public-monitoring-data basis security_profile/sdi_disclosure already use for company/director/holder names), not incidental personal data. Individual remuneration (currremuneration/prevremuneration) is promoted this cut per the user's explicit 2026-07-15 confirmation that it carries the same Web distribution rights as the rest of this table -- individual director remuneration is itself a mandatory annual-report disclosure item, not a separately-collected personal-data field -- overriding the design baseline's conservative default_deny assumption for this field group.
rights_basis.no_field_excluded_for_pii: verified: nq_biography.biography's full column set carries no address, identity-document number, date-of-birth (only integer age), or contact-detail column, so no column in this table was excluded on personal-data grounds (see excluded_from_this_cut for the fields excluded on other grounds).

remuneration_magnitude_verification.method: for every biography row carrying both currremuneration and a nonzero prevremuneration (11590 rows), computed the currremuneration/prevremuneration ratio and bucketed it
remuneration_magnitude_verification.ratio_near_1000x_900_to_1100: 8/11590, isolated to code 1767 (TS Wonders Holding Limited, all 7 of its populated director rows) and 1 row at code 8613 (Oriental Payment Group Holdings Limited)
remuneration_magnitude_verification.other_100x_plus_outliers: 3 rows at codes 2015 and 6888, not near 1000x (e.g. 6888's two rows show a previous-year figure of HKD 1,000 against a current-year figure of HKD 240,000, plausibly a partial-period prior-year figure for a newly appointed director rather than a unit error)
remuneration_magnitude_verification.conclusion: the 1767/8613 ~1000x pattern is a vendor-side scale/unit-encoding inconsistency isolated to 2 companies (4 including the 2 milder outliers) out of 2783 with biography data, not a systemic issue and not a column-mapping error in this promotion. Both fields are promoted verbatim per the no-fallback/no-local-correction discipline -- no corrected value is invented for the affected rows -- and this anomaly is documented here for operator awareness.

excluded_from_this_cut.executive_independent_classification: capacity ('D'|'S') is promoted verbatim; no derived isExecutive/isIndependentNonExecutive/isNonExecutive classification is emitted. That finer classification exists only as free-text prose inside engtitle/chititle (e.g. 'Independent Non-Executive Director'), and the same free text can describe a person's *other* directorships rather than this company's own board classification (verified: one real capacity='S' row's engtitle is 'Deputy Chairman and a Non-executive Director of HTHKH', referring to a different listed entity) -- a keyword-matched classification would misfire on exactly this shape of row, so title is promoted raw instead of interpreted.
excluded_from_this_cut.appointment_departure_dates: nq_biography.biography carries no appointment/departure/tenure date column. curryearend_date/prevyearend_date are the fiscal year-end dates the remuneration figures are reported against, not tenure dates, and are promoted only as remuneration.currentYearEnd/previousYearEnd, never mislabeled as a 'since' or appointment date.
excluded_from_this_cut.committee_membership: no committee-membership column exists in nq_biography.biography. Verified: only 77/32213 rows even mention a committee in free text across all three title columns -- 'committee' in engtitle, or '委員會'/'委员会' in chititle/simtitle (67/32213 for engtitle alone) -- with no structured field anywhere in the mirrored schema. No committees[] array is promoted or derived from free text.
excluded_from_this_cut.cross_directorship_person_graph: this table carries no stable person id (its own unique key is (code, engname, capacity, engtitle)), and this promotion's scope is the per-instrument directors[] list only. A person-level cross-company view is out of scope for this cut and is not built or promoted; no synthetic person id is fabricated in its place.
excluded_from_this_cut.personal_data_columns: verified: nq_biography.biography's full column set (code, chiname/engname/simname, capacity, age, chititle/engtitle/simtitle, chibiography/engbiography/simbiography, remunerationcurrency, curryearend_date, currremuneration, prevyearend_date, prevremuneration) carries no address, identity-document number, date-of-birth, or contact-detail column. No field was excluded on personal-data grounds this cut.

entity_scope_choice.rationale: financial_facts' Serving scope is only codes present in ANY finreport table, because its bank/insurance carve-out needs its own coverage marker distinct from true absence -- there is no comparable 'known but structurally out of scope' bucket for directorate (any listed instrument could in principle have a promoted biography row). Building the full 18036-instrument universe with an explicit coverage.status=unavailable marker (quote_snapshot/corporate_actions/sdi_disclosure's idiom) keeps that distinction, and lets the new DirectorsPanel render a calm EmptyPanel state instead of an error card.

web.synthetic_counterpart: none -- like sdi_disclosure, directorate never had a synthetic scaffold anywhere in packages/workbench: it is a genuinely new tab, not a synthetic->live cutover of an existing one. The tab's status dot therefore has no StockWorkbenchSection key to read and renders neutral rather than a fabricated found/not-found state.

rollback.revert_domain_migration: only if no other serving_dataset row ever adopts domain='directorate'; otherwise the CHECK constraint extension is additive and safe to leave in place
